_about: Round 188 (Robert, 2026-11-08: 'We want the game to be fun and addicting. Have group chat guilds that can give some support but not push the balance, or be able to start our own sect and own guild'). The guild and its chat (scripts/systems/Fellowship.gd) and your own sect (scripts/systems/OwnSect.gd). Support is talk, tips, fair trades, gifts of what you already find, and errands paid at shop prices -- never power. Weekly guild tasks pay renown, and renown buys looks only.
